description: This file defines the main API and internal functions for the Reinforced Autogressive Graph (RAG) ingestion and query system in the LiteLLM project. It provides functions for document ingestion (`ingest`, `aingest`) and querying (`query`, `aquery`) with support for multiple providers, asynchronous execution, and flexible configurations.

methods.name: Type[BaseRAGIngestion] get_ingestion_class(provider: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the provider-specific ingestion class based on the provider name.

methods.description: Executes the ingestion pipeline asynchronously using provider-specific logic.

methods.name: RAGIngestResponse aingest( ingest_options: Dict[str, Any], file_data: Optional[Tuple[str, bytes, str]] = None, file: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, file_url: Optional[str] = None, file_id: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous API to ingest documents into the vector store.

methods.name: ModelResponse _execute_query_pipeline( model: str, messages: List[Any], retrieval_config: Dict[str, Any], rerank: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, stream: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Executes the query pipeline asynchronously, including retrieval and reranking.

methods.description: Asynchronous API to perform a query over the RAG system.
